text:
morgan: Hey — noticed oddity in latency dashboard: service p99 for /v1/generate jumps to ~720ms at 10:12 but endpoint breakdown shows p99 ~230ms. Anyone able to explain why the aggregate and endpoint slice disagree?
lee: Huh, saw the same spike in raw traces. My first guess: different sample origins (proxy vs backend) or retries being counted in one view and not the other.
ana: @morgan can you paste the time range + filters you used? was that the default 'All origins' view?
morgan: Start=2026-03-22T10:00Z end=2026-03-22T10:20Z. I used the dashboard default which I thought was 'client+proxy+server' merge.
lee: I pulled a quick trace sample: ingress log line: `ingress: endpoint=/v1/generate route=eu-west fallback=true latency_ms=702 retry_count=1 origin=proxy`
kai: If retries are included in the aggregate p99 but the endpoint slice is filtered to only 'server' origin, that would explain. We recently changed the console default to hide proxy-origin samples for endpoint slices.
morgan: Ahhh. That would be consistent. But the UI shows no provenance badge for the p99 line right now — that's confusing.
lee: Right — UX gap. We should show a tiny provenance pill (origin: proxy/server/client) next to percentile values, especially when different sources drive a tail.
ana: Also worth checking the routing/policy side: at 10:11 we briefly bumped fallback weight to 20% for eu-west canary; fallback path has higher latency and more retries. If routing weight causes 20% of traffic to route to fallback, aggregate p99 will move but a per-route endpoint slice that excludes fallback won't.
kai: Good catch. ops-bot reports: `deploy-bot: canary/2026-03-22.10 rolled to eu-west at 10:09` — so timing matches.
morgan: So multiple contributors: routing weight change + sample-origin divergence + retries. Action items: 1) add provenance pill to percentile lines, 2) make provenance visible in hover tooltip with sample counts by origin, 3) default endpoint slices to include same origin merge semantics as aggregate or at least show they differ.
lee: I'd also add an "include retries" toggle in the percentile query panel. We have a bunch of dashboards where retries silently skew p99.
kai: Implementation note: backend stores sample origin in a tag `sample_origin`, and retries have `retry_count>0`. Query to reproduce: ```sql
SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 99) as p99, sample_origin, count(*)
FROM telemetry.samples
WHERE endpoint = '/v1/generate' AND time >= '2026-03-22T10:00Z' AND time <= '2026-03-22T10:20Z'
GROUP BY sample_origin
ORDER BY p99 DESC;
```
ana: Nice. We should also provide a small explainer blurb in the docs about why p50/p95/p99 can disagree across slices (sampling origin, retries, routing fallback, KV cache hit variance).
morgan: Agreed. For urgency: can we do a quick UX patch to show provenance pill + sample counts? That would reduce incidents like this being misinterpreted.
kai: I can put up a small PR to the console: badge + tooltip + link to query. Low-risk UI.
lee: I'll add the "include retries" flag to the query service; should be a single param that toggles a `AND retry_count = 0` filter by default.
ana: Who owns the docs blurb? I can draft it and ping docs.
morgan: Thanks team. Let's reconvene after the PRs. Filing a short postmortem note: root cause = rollout + fallback path + unclear provenance display. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: incident-tracker: created incident INC-2026-03122 (latency-dashboard-provenance-mismatch) -> assigned to eng-platform
lee: sweet. I'll add the query above to the incident notes and link traces.
